props.statement: The catalysts can be made much more cheaply than by precipitation methods, and any one catalyst can be duplicated readily in composition and activity, whereas with precipitated catalysts composition, particle size and form, and hence activity, are practically impossible of exact control.

props.name: harder, more coherent, less disintegration

props.statement: The improved catalysts are harder and more coherent than known catalysts, so there is less disintegration in handling and use than with friable catalysts that may be carried away and stop the gas conduits.
